reviews.text: Happy's favorite store, thanks to Adam for his good humor, kindness, and advice. Big plus: the Primal Mini kibble 💜 …
Thank you for your ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Cecilia, we are delighted that you thoroughly enjoyed our local pet shop in Croix-Rousse.
Superb pet shop, the welcome is always pleasant, the manager is friendly and offers good advice. I highly recommend it.
Excellent service. We discovered a superior quality food; our cat is doing much better. A renewed sense of vitality and a beautiful coat are signs of good health. We are now loyal customers.
Thank you Maria for your ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ which truly pleases us, nothing is more pleasant than receiving such a rating which recognizes our daily work.

The shop is perfect for my little dog. The manager is very kind and makes sure the service is excellent from start to finish!

Thank you for your address so I can find Luna's kibble in the south.
We'll stop by next time we're in Lyon.
Thanks again.

Mathilde

Thank you for your warm welcome; my little companions loved your accessories and treats. Adam, the manager, is passionate, and it shows. He will guide you with kindness and professionalism. A small, local business that I truly appreciate.

More than just a pet store.
A small resource center for your pets.
